Anagenesis PRESENT Nikolina & Madman X ODDITY

Παρασκευή 13 Φεβρουαρίου στις 23:59 | Oddity Club

Oddity's glass walls give nothing away from the street. Inside, the room operates on different rules — darkness, bass, the compression of a crowd that's chosen this specific Friday over every other option Gazi offers. The air already carries that particular weight of bodies and intention.

Anagenesis brings Nikolina and Madman X to a venue that matches their intensity. Both artists work the harder edge of electronic music, the kind of programming that doesn't apologize for its demands on the listener. Nikolina's sets pull from the industrial and EBM-inflected end of the spectrum. Madman X brings a different angle on the same darkness. Together they represent a night that commits to its direction without hedging.

The Oddity crowd on nights like this reads as specific. These aren't casual visitors testing the waters. You'll find people who follow Anagenesis bookings, who recognize the names on the lineup and showed up knowing what to expect. Dress code leans dark without requiring it — the real uniform is a certain stance toward the music, bodies that start moving before they're fully in the room. By 2am the floor has achieved that density where individual and collective blur.

Gazi has plenty of venues chasing different demographics. Oddity carved its space by staying committed to bookings that reward the faithful. When Anagenesis brings artists of this caliber, the venue becomes the instrument.

If you want variety and lighter moments, Anagenesis at Oddity will overwhelm you. The programming here operates in a consistent register — intense, uncompromising, designed for those who find release in surrender rather than escapism. But if you've been hunting for the corner of Athens nightlife that treats harder electronic music as serious proposition — you know how to find this room.
